activeQuestion.prompt: Two employees request seats. Who is in the priority group?
activeQuestion.promptZh: 兩名員工申請席位。哪一位屬於優先對象？

options.text: The employee arranging the reception display who never visited a school.
options.zh: 負責接待區展板但沒參與校訪的員工。
options.whyZh: 接待區展覽不是校訪，不能因此獲得優先。

options.text: The employee who helped run a repair session at a school.
options.zh: 曾到學校協助維修活動的員工。
options.whyZh: 這位同仁實際參與校訪，符合優先條件，並不代表保證取得席位。

options.text: The employee who placed the most electronics orders.
options.zh: 下最多電子產品訂單的員工。

options.text: The employee who plans to volunteer at a future school visit.
options.zh: 預計參加日後校訪的員工。
options.whyZh: 尚未參加，不符合曾參與校訪的條件。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: 六個席位先給參與過校訪的同仁；幫忙準備接待區的人若沒去校訪，不屬於優先對象。
activeQuestion.evidence: Six seats; priority will go to employees who took part in the school visits.

group.title: An award announcement
group.passage: F1: Our company won the council's community partnership award. It honors our technicians' volunteer repair sessions at schools, not our sales. Schools wrote to the council about how hands-on activities helped students understand electronics. The ceremony is at the civic center on June twelfth. We have six seats. Employees who joined a school visit get priority. Contact me by Friday if you want a seat. Next month we'll display photos from the program in reception.
group.passageZh: 本公司獲得協會的社區合作獎。獎項表揚的是公司技師在學校辦的志工維修活動，而不是銷售表現。學校寫信給協會，說明動手實作如何幫助學生理解電子學。頒獎典禮在六月十二日於市民中心舉行，公司有六個席位。參與過校訪的員工優先。如需席位，請在週五前聯絡我。下個月會在接待區展示計畫照片。
